facts.fact: 从 Yumi 家回来的路上 Caren 开始头晕，扶着白栅栏的木柱停下，狗 Kugel 在麦冬丛里嗅。
facts.anchor: On the way back from Yumi’s, I start to feel lightheaded.

facts.fact: 她搬进这个“完美”社区近二十年，学到钱解决不了生活抛来的问题；栅栏后的房子常藏着难看的真相。
facts.anchor: I’ve learned the hard way that money cannot solve all the problems life throws at you.

facts.fact: Shawn 说 Miguel 早上上班路上告诉他，她周六派对后摔倒撞了头——脑震荡的消息经由 Miguel 传开。
facts.anchor: He told me you fell and hit your head after the party Saturday night.

facts.fact: Shawn 暗示她是喝多了才摔的；她当面否认 I wasn’t drunk，他回 Don’t shoot the messenger，她表面说 calm、实则 seething。
facts.anchor: “We can’t drink like we used to, am I right?”

facts.fact: 午睡后 Miguel 来电，念研究说休息超过两天反而拖慢恢复，让她别整天躺着。
facts.anchor: The most up-to-date studies show that rest lasting longer than two days can actually hinder recovery.

facts.fact: 她拒绝把庭院义卖的活交给 Kenya，因为办活动是她如今仅剩的意义来源。
facts.anchor: No, I’m not giving up the yard sale.

facts.fact: 她完全忘了 DC 的 Asher 博物馆运营总监 Mara Perez 的初筛视频面试，迟到八分钟才点 Join，形象狼狈。
facts.anchor: It’s the screening call for the job at the Asher Museum in DC.

facts.fact: 面试中她满口行话却什么都没说，Mara 眼神发直；被问眼下是否有工作时她答 Several，其实只有一个客户。
facts.anchor: I continue on this track for a few minutes, offering up gibberish sprinkled with jargon while saying absolutely nothing

facts.fact: Holly Stone 用全大写邮件指那只金手镯是去年入室盗窃的失物，而 Caren 是从 Rachel 要捐给 Goodwill 的袋子底部翻出它并挂上义卖页的。
facts.anchor: I had found it at the bottom of a plastic bag of Rachel’s items destined for Goodwill.

facts.fact: 她翻到去年十二月肯尼迪中心看《胡桃夹子》的照片，手镯正戴在女儿 Rachel 手腕上。
facts.anchor: And dangling on my daughter’s wrist is the gold bangle.
